title: Following up
examples: How long should I wait before sending a follow-up email?
What should I include in a thank-you email after an interview?
Is it okay to send multiple follow-ups if I don't hear back?

explain.say: A thank-you email is important after meeting someone new.

items: Reiterating interest in the next step

explain.say: When writing, always keep your tone professional and polite.
Timing for a follow-up email is crucial for good impressions.
If you do not hear back, wait a reasonable amount of time.
Always proofread your email carefully before hitting send.
In a real job search, you might follow up after a networking event.

faq.q: How long should I wait before sending a follow-up email?
faq.a: For initial contacts, waiting about one week is generally appropriate. You can also wait 24 hours after an interview.
asks: What is the right time to follow up?
How long should I wait to hear back?

faq.q: What is the best way to structure a thank-you email?
faq.a: Start by thanking them specifically for their time. Then, mention one thing you discussed to show you were listening.
asks: What goes in a thank you email?
How do I write a good thank you note?

faq.q: If I send a follow-up and get no reply, should I keep emailing?
faq.a: It is best to send one or two polite follow-ups, but do not bombard them with emails. Respect their time.
asks: How many times should I follow up?
What if they do not respond?

faq.q: Should I use casual language in professional emails?
faq.a: No, always maintain a formal and respectful tone. Avoid slang or overly casual greetings.
asks: Is it okay to be casual?

faq.q: Does the content of the thank-you email change based on the meeting?
faq.a: Yes, tailor it. If it was an interview, focus on skills. If it was a casual chat, focus on shared interests.
asks: Should I change the email content?

facts: A thank-you email should be sent within 24 hours of the meeting.
Always proofread for spelling and grammar before sending any professional correspondence.
When following up, reference a specific detail from your previous conversation.
Maintain a formal and respectful tone throughout all professional emails.

quiz.say: You met a potential mentor at a conference. When should you send the initial thank-you email?

options.show: Only if they ask for it
options.say: Only if they ask for it

quiz.why: Sending it quickly shows you are organized and enthusiastic about the connection.

wrong.0: This is too long and suggests a lack of immediate interest.
wrong.1: This is vague; 24 hours is a clearer, more immediate timeframe.
wrong.2: Sending one proactively is always better than waiting for them to ask.

quiz.say: When following up after an interview, what should be mentioned in the email?
quiz.show: A) A general statement of thanks

options.show: Only asking for the next steps
options.say: Only asking for the next steps

options.show: A long summary of your resume
options.say: A long summary of your resume

quiz.why: Mentioning a detail proves you were actively listening during the conversation.

wrong.0: You must first thank them before asking for anything.
wrong.1: The email should be brief; they already have your resume.
wrong.3: This is too vague and could be sent to anyone.

quiz.say: If you sent an initial email and receive no reply after a week, what is the best next action?
quiz.show: A) Send a very short, polite follow-up

options.show: Send a very short, polite follow-up
options.say: Send a very short, polite follow-up

options.show: Send a formal letter via post
options.say: Send a formal letter via post

options.show: Send a group email to multiple people
options.say: Send a group email to multiple people

quiz.why: A gentle reminder is appropriate after a reasonable waiting period like one week.

wrong.1: This can feel overly dramatic or demanding for a simple follow-up.
wrong.2: Waiting too long might cause the connection to fade completely.
wrong.3: This is unprofessional and makes the recipient feel exposed.
